text:
deploy-bot: [PROD][us-east-1] rollback initiated for release tag v1.4.9 -> v1.4.8. Initiator: sam. Reason: canary 95th latency spike (+120ms) and error-rate bump in service 'runtime-api'. Commit: 8f3c2b7. Change window: immediate.

sam: starting coordination — will unpin v1.4.9 and roll back canary first. tagging ops.

aya: ack. please confirm that any in-flight jobs are drained and we preserve KV cache compatibility. also, pin v1.4.8 after rollback. :eyes:

leo: logging shows OOMs on one host, correlates to kernel change in image. recommend revert to v1.4.8 and hold canary at 50% while we validate.

maria: FYI product impacted flows: embeddings batch and autocomplete. notifying support.

sam: executing revert deploy now. command:```sh
reployctl revert --env prod-us-east-1 --from v1.4.9 --to v1.4.8 --strategy canary --canary-percent 50 --drain 60s
```

opsbot: deploy action started: job id dpl-2026-04-09-92. Targets: runtime-api replicas in us-east-1.

deploy-bot: [PROD][us-east-1] revert step: canary rollout 50% -> 100% in progress. Actions: unpin v1.4.9 from default routing.

sam: quick health snapshots during canary:
```
canary-1: 95p latency 320ms -> stable
canary-2: OOM spikes stopped
errors/s: 2 -> 0.3
```

aya: good signal. proceed to full rollback and pin v1.4.8. post-mortem later with root cause.

leo: running post-rollback sanity: KV cache integrity checks, rolling restart on 3 nodes to clear kernel issue.

deploy-bot: [PROD][us-east-1] revert deploy completed. release now: v1.4.8. Downtime: 0. Rolling restart: completed.

deploy-bot: release pin updated: default-route -> v1.4.8 (was v1.4.9). Pin metadata: reason=latency-spike, initiated_by=sam, audit_id=dpl-2026-04-09-92.

maria: confirming support notified. sending canned messages to affected customers.

aya: thanks everyone. action items: (1) sam/leo investigate image/kernel diff and produce RCA draft; (2) eng-releases to add a preflight to catch this class of regression; (3) schedule hotfix if needed.

sam: noted. reopening a canary-only channel for deeper debugging.

opsbot: audit entry created: dpl-2026-04-09-92 -> rollback -> completed.

deploy-bot: [PROD][us-east-1] final status: rollback completed, v1.4.8 pinned, canary metrics stable.

leo: reaction :thumbsup:. moving to postmortem.

aya: adding this to release notes under 'rollback & revert' with timeline. will attach linking audit id.

sam: closing thread. ping if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
